Retry delays grow exponentially and include jitter

tasks.last_result: Adapters corrected; all 73 tests pass. NVIDIA GPT-OSS 20B returned OK; planner and coder router smoke calls succeeded via NVIDIA GPT-OSS. Gemini GenerateContent returned HTTP 200/OK once but subsequent calls returned HTTP 503. NVIDIA GLM-5.3 and DeepSeek timed out at 60 seconds. Groq returned HTTP 403 again on a minimal streaming generation. Tester route remains unconfirmed; further calls paused to limit free-tier RPM. Phase remains in review pending provider access. Provider engine now also wires OpenRouter and Mistral through the shared Chat Completions adapter; model routes were not selected or changed. Gemini errors now surface a sanitized provider message for 5xx diagnostics, and unsupported MINIMAL thinking is rejected. 74 unit tests pass. Live Gemini calls still returned HTTP 503 on both Gemini 3.8 and 3.7 with and without generationConfig; that service/account issue remains unresolved. Bounded exponential backoff with jitter is now available for retryable 429/5xx/network errors; the local config and example enable two retries maximum. Official Google documentation recommends bounded exponential backoff for 503/429, but does not establish free-tier status as the cause of these failures. 75 tests pass. Gemini account/service availability remains unresolved.
